description: Query an Azure AI Search index and materialize results as a DataFrame. Supports keyword search, OData filters, semantic ranker, and (with index config) vector search.

api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the query API key. Omit to use DefaultAzureCredential.
api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var

search_text.description: Search text (default '*' returns all docs subject to filter/top)
search_text.label: Search Text

filter_query.description: OData $filter expression, e.g. "category eq 'Electronics' and price gt 100"
filter_query.label: Filter Query

select.description: Optional column projection — list of field names
select.label: Select

top.description: Max results to return (Azure max 1000 per request)
top.label: Top

semantic_configuration_name.description: Optional semantic ranker configuration name (requires Standard tier and a configured semantic config)
semantic_configuration_name.label: Semantic Configuration Name

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds
